question: Haven B, 1v1 clutch, spike planted, 20s. You are Omen (1 smoke, Paranoia, Shrouded Step) at B Entrance. The last ATK guards the spike somewhere on B Site. How do you clutch?

options.label: Smoke one side of the site to isolate the duel to 1 angle, then peek the other side for a clean 1v1
options.explication_courte: In a 1v1 you convert the retake into a single duel: the smoke cuts one angle, you only peek one line, making it a pure 1v1 on your terms.

options.label: Use Paranoia through the site to blind the ATK and enter on the flash, positioning behind util
options.explication_courte: Paranoia clears an angle and can open an entry, but you expose yourself to multiple positions at once if the flash misses the exact angle.

sources_option.citation: Utility should block vision, force movement, buy time, or make the next duel easier; a flash helps entry but only if it covers the angle the enemy actually holds.

options.label: Rush directly toward the spike to start the defuse and force the ATK to reveal themselves to stop you
options.explication_courte: Rushing the defuse without clearing exposes you to any prepared angle: the ATK who is pre-aimed kills you mid-defuse. Never defuse before clearing.

sources_option.citation: Don't rush onto the spike blind against an unknown holder; defusing exposed lets a prepared angle-holder shoot you while you're locked in the defuse.

options.label: Wait passively at B Entrance without using util until the last second, hoping the ATK makes a mistake
options.explication_courte: Waiting without acting gives the round to the ATK: the spike detonates, the enemy has no reason to move, and you waste all your util.

sources_option.citation: The clock is a secondary opponent; in a post-plant clutch you must act to force the duel, waiting passively lets the spike detonate for free.

explication_longue:
Situation: Haven B, 1v1 clutch, spike planted, 20 seconds. You are Omen at B Entrance with a smoke (Dark Cover), Paranoia, Shrouded Step. The last ATK guards the spike somewhere on B Site.

One-vs-one clutch principles: (1) never peek multiple angles simultaneously, (2) use util to isolate the duel to a single angle, (3) never start the defuse before the site is clear. Omen is the best 1v1 clutch agent: his smoke creates a controlled information environment.

Optimal sequence: smoke one side of the site (e.g. B Screen or the back wall angle), then peek only the unsmoked side - the ATK can only be in one of the two halves, and you are only peeking one. If the peek misses, Shrouded Step gives repositioning. Paranoia (acceptable) can blind an angle and open entry but risks exposing you to multiple lines. Rushing the defuse (costly) is a classic panic play - pre-aimed angles punish defuse-first every time. Passive waiting (mistake) gives the round to the clock.

Estimated elite distribution: ~54% smoke + isolate peek, ~22% Paranoia entry, ~16% rush defuse (costly), ~6% passive wait (mistake).

sources.citation: Turn a 1vX into a series of 1v1s; changing your spot isolates duels, and utility should block vision, force movement, buy time, or ease the next duel.
Isolating duels — peeking only enough to see one opponent at a time — is the key to winning clutch situations.
In a post-plant clutch the defuse timer forces action; control which angle the duel happens on rather than defusing blind against an unknown holder.

_gaps.incertitude: Smoke-isolate (optimal) vs Paranoia-entry (acceptable) depend de si Omen a lu la position approximative de l'ATK ; avec une info claire, Paranoia sur le bon angle peut egaler l'optimal. Position ATK inconnue par design.
La position exacte du dernier ATK (sur le spike, en angle off-site, ou lurk retour) n'est pas connue ; c'est la variable qui rendrait un juge Immortal+ nuance sur l'ordre smoke vs peek.
Estimations depuis guides clutch/defuse (boosteria, dignitas, valocheck) ; pas de dataset public sur la frequence smoke-isolate vs flash-entry en 1v1 retake par elo.
